create_shader_program: create a gl.AbstractShaderProgram, attach vertex and fragment shaders, link, and set uniform values
create_buffer: create a gl.Buffer and set data from bytes or an array of floats
create_framebuffer: create a gl.Framebuffer, attach a renderbuffer or texture, and read pixel data into an image
create_mesh: create a gl.Mesh, add vertex buffers with attributes, and set an index buffer
create_texture2d: create a gl.Texture2D, set storage and subimage data, and configure minification and magnification filters
